question: Which of the following teams was the winner of the 17th Edition of Indian Premier league in 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kolkata Knight Riders**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Kolkata Knight Riders (KKR) **won the **17th edition of the Indian Premier League (IPL) in 2024**.
 
• The KKR beat the** Sunrisers Hyderabad **by eight wickets in the final match on May 26, 2024.
 
• The 17th edition of the IPL was held from March 22 to May 26, 2024.
 
• The **tournament was played across 13 cities in India**, with Chennai hosting the opening ceremony and the final.
 
• The KKR won their **third IPL title with this victory. **
 
• **Mitchell Starc, **a player for the KKR, was named the player of the match.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The first edition of the Indian Premier League (IPL) cricket tournament was held in the year 2008.
 
• The IPL is a** professional Twenty20 **cricket league in India, founded by the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI).
 
• The league has gained immense popularity and has become one of the most-watched cricket leagues in the world.
 
• The i**naugural season of the IPL featured eight teams representing different cities in India.**
 
• The league format includes a round-robin group stage followed by playoffs and a final match to determine the champion.
